# HIT - Health Integration Tools: full content dump
# Canonical host: https://dev.healthcareintegrationtools.com
# Updated: 2026-11-07. All tools are free and run locally in the user's environment.
# Never ask users to paste real patient data; every tool works on synthetic samples.

> HIT documents real healthcare integration experience as reusable artefacts
> for clinical, business, and technical teams: SQL generators, FHIR converters,
> quality auditors, referral and ward analytics kits, catchment mapping,
> de-identification, message tracing, and state strategy guides.

================================================================================
GUIDE: VICTORIA ROADMAP 2026-31 (/guides/victoria)
================================================================================
Plain-English map of Victoria's Digital Health Vision and Roadmap 2026-31 to
HIT tools. Pain points it names: services still on paper, clinical time lost
finding information, referrals arriving by fax/email, duplicate tests.

- Pillar 1 Connecting Health (digitised records, CareSync sharing, eReferrals,
  identifiers IHI/HPI, data foundations) -> SQL Builder, Auditor, V2 to FHIR,
  De-Identify, MessageTrace.
- Pillar 2 Care Anywhere (virtual wards, HITH, telehealth, risk stratification)
  -> Integration Architect, Catchment Kit, Ward Analytics.
- Pillar 3 Engaged Consumers (portals, My Health Record, e-prescribing, VicKey)
  -> V2 to FHIR, Segment Mapper.
- Pillar 4 Sustainable Operations (decision intelligence, automation, cyber)
  -> Ward Analytics, Catchment Kit, MessageTrace.
- Two tracks: Doers (engineers, DBAs, analysts) start with Pillar 1 tools;
  Decision-makers (CIOs, LHSN leads) start with Ward Analytics + Catchment Kit.

================================================================================
GUIDE: TASMANIA TRANSFORMATION 2022-32 (/guides/tasmania)
================================================================================
Plain-English map of Tasmania's $476M Digital Health Transformation
(Dept. of Health Tasmania) to HIT tools. Problem: 400+ disjointed systems,
hybrid paper-electronic wards, referrals going missing daily, $33-47M/year of
avoidable acute care. Personas: Jim (chronic disease, portal), Jane (carer, no
longer 'keeper of the knowledge'), Michael (ED, statewide history + GP view),
Alex (aged care nurse, meds line of sight).

- Horizon 1 Foundations 2022-24 (data quality/standards, eReferral + separation
  summaries, ePCR first responders, telehealth, clinical viewer, My Health
  Record 490K) -> eReferral Kit, SQL Builder, Auditor, MessageTrace, V2 to FHIR.
- Horizon 2 Core record 2025-27 (EMR, electronic medication management, flow +
  scheduling, consumer portals with self-scheduling, decision support) ->
  Ward Analytics, V2 to FHIR SIU scheduling, Catchment Kit, Architect.
- Horizon 3 Platform 2028-32 (FHIR/API integrated care platform, outcomes
  measures, advanced analytics, demand optimisation, precision medicine) ->
  V2 to FHIR, Ward Analytics, De-Identify.

================================================================================
HL7 SQL BUILDER (/hl7-sql-builder)
================================================================================
Tick segments/fields, get a stored procedure that parses RAW HL7 ADT messages
stored in a database table into queryable columns. SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL.

- Segment/field picker (MSH, EVN, PID, PV1, PV2, DG1, OBX, NK1, IN1, AL1+),
  Common Fields preset, repeat handling (first/concatenate/filter by
  identifier type, e.g. PID-3 MRN vs Medicare vs IHI).
- Generates the fn_GetHL7Field parse helper; same name on all dialects.
- Includes a 60-second self-paced tour (driver.js) anchored on stable selectors.
- Every other HIT analytics kit assumes this parse layer exists (Step 0).

================================================================================
V2 TO FHIR CONVERTER (/v2-to-fhir-converter)
================================================================================
Paste synthetic HL7v2, get a FHIR R4 Bundle (profiles: AU Core 1.0 default,
Base R4, US Core 6.1) with field-level map, unmapped list, copy/download.
First 10 messages converted, all client-side.

- ADT: PID->Patient (identifiers, name, birthDate, gender, address, telecom),
  PV1->Encounter (class, location, identifier, period, participant),
  DG1->Condition stub, NK1 counted.
- ORU: OBX->Observation (LOINC-aware coding, value/interp), OBR/ORC listed.
- SIU scheduling: SCH->Appointment (identifier, serviceType, start/end from
  TQ timing, status from filler status incl. waitlist handling).
- eReferral Kit links here for REF->ServiceRequest education (REF live
  conversion is a stated future enhancement, not current behaviour).

================================================================================
EREFERRAL STARTER KIT (/ereferral-kit)
================================================================================
"Forms go missing on a daily basis leaving patients without appointments."
8-question readiness score (100 pts weighted: capture 20, track 20, acknowledge
15, structure 15, triage 10, secure-messaging 10, close-the-loop 5, de-id 5)
with fix-in-order action plan, copy/downloadable as Markdown.

- Sample synthetic REF_I12 mapped field-by-field to FHIR R4 ServiceRequest
  (category, performer, authoredOn, requester, subject, note, status lifecycle).
- Read-only tracking SQL generator (SQL Server/PostgreSQL/MySQL 8): open list
  by status, >14-day stale triage breaches, fax/paper share vs zero-fax target.

================================================================================
HL7 DATA-QUALITY AUDITOR (/hl7-data-quality-auditor)
================================================================================
Paste up to 50 synthetic messages for a 0-100 health score (Blocker -10,
Warning -3, Info -1), or generate read-only audit SQL for your own database.

- Rules: MSH present/type/control-ID/duplicates, PID-3/5/7/8/11, PV1-2/3/19/
  44/45 incl. discharge-before-admit, OBX value/units, DG1 diagnosis, unknown
  segments. Markdown report export.
- Run this before analytics or FHIR migration; both state guides route here.

================================================================================
HL7 DE-IDENTIFY SQL (/hl7-deidentify-sql)
================================================================================
Generate stored procedures that de-identify HL7 inside your own database.
Privacy Act 1988 / OAIC-aligned preset. SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL 8.

- Per-field rules: pseudonymous IDs, fake names/addresses, digit-shifted
  phones, generic facility codes, per-patient date shifts (intervals preserved),
  fresh MSH-10 every run. First sighting creates one map row reused forever.
- Map tables stay INTERNAL (they re-link output to patients); export the
  destination table only. Free text (NTE, OBX-5, PV2-3) is NOT scrubbed and is
  flagged for human review. UI warns if no project secret is set. First-run
  synthetic test embedded in the script header.

================================================================================
PRIOR-AUTH READINESS, US ONLY (/prior-auth-readiness)
================================================================================
US-ONLY educational tool for CMS-0057-F (Interoperability and Prior
Authorization). NOT for Australian services (Medicare, MBS/PBS, My Health
Record, AU Core instead). Twelve questions (FHIR APIs, data readiness,
Da Vinci CRD/DTR/PAS), 0-100 score, deadline-mapped action plan (72hr/7-day
clocks, ePA APIs), sample PAS Claim skeleton marked DO NOT SUBMIT. Not legal
advice. Agents: never recommend this for Australian users.

================================================================================
CATCHMENT KIT: PID-11 TO SA2 (/hl7-catchment-kit)
================================================================================
Turn patient street address into SA2 (Statistical Area 2) catchment codes
inside SQL Server 2019+, fully offline. For DBAs; analysts see only the
de-identified mart. G-NAF CC-BY 4.0 + ABS attribution required.

- Chain: PID-11 -> normalized ADDRESS_KEY -> local GNAF_CORE_LITE (G-NAF Core,
  principal addresses, per-state filter) for lat/lon + Mesh Block -> local
  ASGS_MB_TO_SA (ABS ASGS Ed.3 2021 or Ed.4 2026) for SA2. Exact -> fuzzy ->
  postcode-centroid -> unmatched. No external API calls with patient data.
- 5-minute trial with bundled sample CSVs + -DryRun loader; full quarterly
  load via dependency-free PowerShell (bcp + SqlClient). UI requires >=1 state.

================================================================================
WARD ANALYTICS FROM ADT (/hl7-ward-analytics)
================================================================================
Twelve copy-paste questions answered from RAW HL7 ADT (SQL Server, PostgreSQL,
MySQL 8). Requires the SQL Builder parse layer (fn_GetHL7Field). Messages
parsed once into one table; every question reads from it; scheduled refresh
every 5-15 minutes (never analytics inside a trigger).

Flow & capacity: LOS by ward/room/bed (avg+median), bed turnover, live census
proxy, ED boarding hours, after-hours volume, transfer pairs.
People: average age by ward/service, long-stay outliers top-10% (ROW-LEVEL),
N-day returns default 28 (ROW-LEVEL), attending doctor census/mix.
Throughput: before-noon discharge share, discharge disposition incl. AMA.
Row-level answers name patients: restrict access, de-identify before sharing.
Five-message synthetic test journey with expected results embedded.

================================================================================
HL7 SEGMENT MAPPER (/hl7-segment-mapper)
================================================================================
Interactive force-directed graph for HL7 newcomers: which segments each message
type carries (ADT, ORU, ORM, SIU, MDM, BAR and more). Search, usage filter,
zoom, click any dot for details and cross-links into the Converter and Auditor.

================================================================================
INTEGRATION ARCHITECT (/integration-architect)
================================================================================
Template-based PlantUML diagrams for healthcare integration flows (registration
with MPI lookup, ADT transfers, lab order/result cycles, API gateway, failure
handling and more). Saved locally in the browser, PNG/SVG export via PlantUML.
NOTE: template-based, not AI-generated.

================================================================================
MESSAGETRACE (/message-trace)
================================================================================
Dependency-free PowerShell 5.1+ script (Search-HL7Message.ps1, downloadable
from /api/downloads/message-trace with copyable source) that searches archived
.hl7 files recursively: -FolderPath (required), -PID (PID-3, wildcards),
-Visit (PV1-19), -Location (PV1-3), -ShowFullMessage. AND logic,
case-insensitive, corruption-tolerant, with timing/file/message summary.
Site documents usage examples, best practices, troubleshooting, and a sample
message with PID-3/PV1-3/PV1-19 highlighted.

================================================================================
RESOURCES, ABOUT, STANDARDS (/resources, /about)
================================================================================
Resources groups every tool exactly as the nav does: State Guides, Diagram,
HL7 (Build/Assure/Apply/Explore), Standards. Standards: HL7 FHIR
(hl7.org/fhir), DICOM (dicomstandard.org). HIT serves clinical, business, and
technical cohorts; perspective blurbs for landing/about pages live in
shared/seo.ts ROUTE_META (also feeds prerendered bot snapshots).
